title: Mage Wars

basic.title: First Game Flow: Read, Prepare, Resolve
basic.description: Start with the win condition, mage readouts, channeling, and planning, then continue through summoning, movement, walls, guard, healing, and status removal.

wallAndLineOfSight.title: Continuation: Walls, Line of Sight, Passage
wallAndLineOfSight.description: Walls are placed on zone borders; blocked line of sight prevents choosing that object or zone as a target.

guard.title: Continuation: Guard
guard.description: A creature may choose to take a quick action to guard, protecting its zone and gaining Counterstrike.

healing.title: Continuation: Healing
healing.description: Healing removes damage from living creatures and conjurations.

restoreAndBurn.title: Continuation: Burn And Restore
restoreAndBurn.description: The removal cost for a Burn marker is 2; Restore may pay removal costs to remove status markers.

steps.setup: During Deployment, continue with a wall. A wall is placed on a zone border, the line between two zones.
steps.wallPurpose: A wall is a subtype of conjuration spell. Walls are always placed on zone borders.
steps.castThornsWall: Choose “Wall of Thorns” in your prepared spells, then click the edge between Left Rear and Center-Left Rear. The highlighted target is the legal wall edge, not a whole zone.
steps.wallCardOnEdge: After the wall resolves, the edge shows the Wall of Thorns card face. That border has a wall.
steps.lineOfSightAndPassage: If line of sight to an object or zone is blocked, you cannot choose it as a target. Every creature that passes through this wall is automatically attacked by the wall; the attack happens before the creature moves.

steps.setup: During the Action Stage, continue with Guard. A creature may choose to take a quick action to guard, protecting its zone and gaining Counterstrike.
steps.guardRule: When making a melee attack, if there is an enemy guard in your zone, you must attack the enemy guard. A melee attack removes the Guard marker from the guarding creature.
steps.guardCleric: Click the Asyran Cleric on the right, then click “Guard” in the lower action dock. The Guard marker is the result after the action resolves, not a skill or target you click first.
steps.guardTokenResult: The Asyran Cleric gains a Guard marker. The Guard marker is directly below the unit card.

steps.setup: During the Action Stage, continue with Healing. Healing removes damage from living creatures and conjurations.
steps.healingRule: Asyran Cleric: Healing Light is a full action ability at range 0-1, targets a living creature, and heals damage equal to the die result.
steps.healWoundedBobcat: Click the Asyran Cleric in the same zone, click “Healing Light”, then click the wounded Wild Bobcat.
steps.healingResultAndLifeReadout: Healing removes damage from living creatures and conjurations. The Wild Bobcat has less damage; the life readout shows current remaining life.
steps.lifeToggle: Click the eye button to show all life readouts; click it again to turn always-visible readouts off.

steps.setup: For status handling, continue with Burn and Restore. The removal cost for a Burn marker is 2.
steps.burnRule: Burn means the object is on fire and is a flame condition. During each Upkeep Phase, roll one attack die for each Burn marker on each object and deal direct damage. On a 0, remove that Burn marker.
steps.restoreBurningCleric: Click the Priestess mage body, click “Restore”, then click the Asyran Cleric with the Burn token. Restore targets a creature within 1 zone and pays the removal cost to remove one status type.
steps.restoreResult: The Burn marker is removed. After status removal, the Burn token is gone from the target card, and the mage mana and action marker have changed.

steps.intro: Mage Wars lasts several rounds, until one mage has taken enough damage to be destroyed. The last mage standing wins the game.
steps.selfHud: Your mage panel shows life, damage, mana, channeling, action marker, and quickcast marker. Apprentice mages start with Life 24, Mana 10, and Channeling 10; your goal is to deal enough damage to defeat the opposing mage.
steps.opponentHud: The opponent panel shows the same readouts. Opponent prepared spells use card backs and a count, so card names stay hidden until revealed.
steps.stage: Each game round has two stages: the Ready Stage and the Action Stage. The Action Stage begins after the Ready Stage is complete.
steps.advanceChannel: Click “End Turn” to finish the Reset Phase. During the Channel Phase, each mage adds mana equal to its channeling value to its mana supply.
steps.channelResult: The Beastmaster currently has Channeling 10; after channeling, the mana supply gains 10 mana.
steps.advanceUpkeep: Some spells have upkeep costs; some spells and conditions take effect during Upkeep. There is no upkeep cost in this position, so click “End Turn”.
steps.advancePlanning: Planning Phase: each mage chooses up to 2 spells from their spellbook for this round. Click “End Turn” to open the spellbook.
steps.planWolf: Choose Creature, go to the next page, and select “Jungle Wolf”; then choose Incantation, go to the next page, select “Rouse the Beast”, and click “Prepare 2”. Rouse the Beast: choose a creature summoned this round and turn its action marker active side up.
steps.preparedAndHidden: Both players choose their own spells at the same time. Your chosen spells are kept hidden from the opponent so they cannot know your plan.
steps.deployWolf: Choose “Jungle Wolf” in your prepared spells, then click the Beastmaster's zone. Summoning: when you cast a creature spell, it is also called summoning a creature.
steps.rouseWolf: Choose “Rouse the Beast” in your prepared spells, then click Jungle Wolf in the arena. Turn the target creature's action marker active side up.
steps.passYourDeployment: Deployment begins with the starting player. Click “End Turn” to let the opponent deploy.
steps.opponentDeploy: The opponent casts Asyran Cleric. Asyran Cleric: Creature / Cleric, Life 6, Armor 1, Staff quick melee 2 dice.
steps.opponentAttackSpell: Pillar of Light: Attack / Light, range 0-2, target creature or conjuration, 2 attack dice; effect die 4-10 Daze, 11+ Stun.
steps.discardReading: Each player has their own discard pile. All destroyed objects and spells discarded after casting are placed in the discard pile.
steps.skipToCreatureAction: Action Stage: starting with the starting player, players take turns using their creatures to take action phases until all creatures have acted.
steps.moveWolf: Click Jungle Wolf, then click an adjacent zone to move it. During a creature's action phase, it can take a move action to move from one zone to another.
steps.finish: You have now read the board, channeled, planned, summoned, roused a creature, checked public discard, and moved. Continue to walls, guard, healing, and status removal.
